# Birch Aluminum

> Birch Aluminum is developing an automated secondary aluminum alloy facility in Decatur, Alabama, converting qualified domestic scrap into 356 and A380 alloys for U.S. industrial buyers.

Stage 1 targets 6M lbs/month and 72M lbs/year of alloy capacity with a 97% target metal recovery rate. The capital plan calls for $17.5M of permanent capital and a $10M working-capital facility, followed by a planned $19M die-casting expansion.
